Messages.Author: Joseph Sordetto
Messages.Body:
I've seen these cards that that call for -1 stealth. Does this mean
that you must have at least +1 stealth to do the deed?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <4ali04$o...@cloner3.netcom.com>,

Joseph Sordetto <js...@ix.netcom.com> wrote:
>I've seen these cards that that call for -1 stealth. Does this mean
>that you must have at least +1 stealth to do the deed?

No, you may complete an action at negative stealth, it's simply very
easy to block you (anyone at zero or even -1 intercept can catch you).
